data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3 (local half): create-dso-app.sh writes merge.strategy=direct, enforcement.strategy=local to new project's dso-config.conf and does NOT provision a Ruleset

## Implementation

File: scripts/create-dso-app.sh (modify)

After the existing dso.plugin_root write (Step 5b), add two config key writes to the new project's .claude/dso-config.conf:
  printf 'merge.strategy=direct\n' >> "$project_dir/.claude/dso-config.conf"
  printf 'enforcement.strategy=local\n' >> "$project_dir/.claude/dso-config.conf"

Behavior: installer always writes these defaults (overwrite intentional — installer establishes initial defaults; users modify post-install). Add an inline comment to this effect.

Do NOT call provision-ruleset.sh from create-dso-app.sh.

## TDD Requirement
Modify tests/scripts/test-create-dso-app.sh to add test_installer_writes_merge_strategy_defaults BEFORE implementing:
- Create a temp dir (mktemp -d) for the sentinel file
- Stub provision-ruleset.sh in a temp PATH bin dir (mktemp -d) to write a sentinel file to the temp dir if invoked
- Run create-dso-app.sh on a temp project dir
- Assert: (1) .claude/dso-config.conf contains merge.strategy=direct; (2) contains enforcement.strategy=local; (3) sentinel file does NOT exist (provision-ruleset.sh was never called)
This test must FAIL (RED) before implementation — the config keys don't exist yet.
Then implement the two config writes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-create-dso-app.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] test_installer_writes_merge_strategy_defaults passes
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-create-dso-app.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'test_installer_writes_merge_strategy_defaults.*PASS'
- [ ] merge.strategy=direct written to project config (covered by test above)
- [ ] enforcement.strategy=local written to project config (covered by test above)
- [ ] provision-ruleset.sh not invoked (behavioral stub sentinel in test above)

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet->opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Update create-dso-app.sh to write merge.strategy=direct and enforcement.strategy=local
